title: Khan Academy — Percent word problems
description: Foundational walkthroughs of percentage word problems, useful if the base concept (not the exam shortcut) feels shaky.

title: Wolfram MathWorld — Ratio
description: Formal mathematical definition of ratio and proportion for readers who want the underlying theory.

title: Khan Academy — Rate problems
description: Core distance/speed/time relationships before applying exam-specific relative-speed shortcuts.

title: Wolfram MathWorld — Arithmetic Sequence
description: Formal definition of arithmetic sequences underlying difference-based number series questions.

title: Khan Academy — Introduction to compound interest
description: Builds compound interest up from the simple-interest formula, useful for seeing exactly where the (1+R/100)ⁿ term comes from.

title: Khan Academy — Angles of elevation and depression
description: Explains the elevation/depression angle setup that every Heights and Distances question is built on.

title: Khan Academy — Permutations and combinations
description: Practice set distinguishing when order matters (permutations) from when it doesn't (combinations).

title: Khan Academy — Probability with permutations and combinations
description: Combines counting techniques with probability — good next step once basic favorable/total probability feels easy.

title: Khan Academy — Simplifying numerical expressions (order of operations)
description: Walks through evaluating multi-operation expressions using brackets and parentheses — the exact skill BODMAS/simplification questions test.

title: Khan Academy — Solving quadratic equations by factoring
description: Covers the factoring method used to find both roots of a quadratic — the foundation this app's root-comparison shortcut builds on.

title: Khan Academy (India) — Statistics: the average
description: India-curriculum introduction to the arithmetic mean, useful if the base concept (not the exam speed method) needs reinforcing.

title: Khan Academy (India) — Intro to profit and loss
description: India CBSE-curriculum explanation of cost price, selling price and profit/loss — same terminology this app's Profit & Loss topic uses.

title: Khan Academy — Area and volume of solids (mensuration)
description: General formulas for area, surface area and volume across common 2D and 3D shapes, in a unit explicitly titled 'Mensuration'.

title: Khan Academy — Intro to logarithms
description: Explains what a logarithm actually asks ('what power gives this value'), the inverse relationship this app's shortcut relies on.

title: Khan Academy — Exponent properties review
description: Reviews the core index laws (multiplying, dividing, powers of powers) this topic's shortcuts are built directly on.

title: Khan Academy — Age word problem: Arman & Diya
description: Worked age word problem showing how to translate a ratio-and-future-condition age question into solvable equations.
